card.name: Number-like word starts inside words
card.fires_on: Pieces that look like number words (Dos, ten, Nine, two, five, Tres) at the start or middle of a longer word, such as Dos-age or ten-ofovir.

modes.label: Dos- in dosage headings
modes.description: The piece Dos opening the word dosage in section headings of drug labels.

modes.label: ten- in tenofovir
modes.description: The piece ten inside the drug name tenofovir after a slash.

modes.label: Number words in other words
modes.description: Spelled-out numbers like Tres, five, Nine or two that begin or sit within a longer word or phrase.

card.plain: It fires on little chunks that look like number words but are really parts of longer words like dosage or tenofovir.
